displayName: Document details on the title page
description: Draws a block of labelled document details on the title page, one per line. List them with :title-block-details: Document ID=document-id, Classification=classification — a bare attribute name renders without a label, and a detail whose attribute is unset is omitted. Note the narrow scope: interpolating attributes into the title block onto ONE line is already possible with the built-in title-page.authors.content theme key, so enable this only when you need the details laid out on separate lines.

themeKeys.description: Alignment of the details block. Follows the title page's alignment by default.
Colour of the details block's text.
Space between the rest of the title page and the details block.

sampleContent: Labelled document details — identifier, classification, organisation — are laid out on the title page, one per line.
